# ResultantAI

> AI automation consultancy building production voice AI systems, workflow automation, and revenue operations infrastructure for small and mid-market businesses. Founded by Chris Mott in Clayton, California.

## About

ResultantAI is an independent AI automation consultancy, not affiliated with Resultant (resultant.com), the Indianapolis technology and data firm formerly known as KSM Consulting.

Chris Mott founded ResultantAI after fifteen years in B2B go-to-market and revenue operations at companies including EVERFI and Metadata.io. He now builds AI automation systems in production for service businesses, agencies, and B2B companies.

Contact: chris@resultantai.com
Website: https://resultantai.com
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/chrismott1
Company: https://www.linkedin.com/company/resultantai

## Services

### Voice AI Agents — from $10,000
AI phone systems built on Retell AI that handle inbound calls 24/7, qualify leads, book appointments, and route emergencies. HIPAA-compliant configurations available.
- https://resultantai.com/lp/voice-ai/

### Workflow Automation — from $5,000
Make.com and n8n workflows that eliminate manual processes: ticket creation, invoice generation, CRM sync, follow-up sequences, report generation.
- https://resultantai.com/lp/b2b-automation/

### Agency AI Systems
White-label automation and per-client AI cost attribution for marketing agencies.
- https://resultantai.com/lp/agency-automation/

### Pricing
- https://resultantai.com/pricing/
